title: PIXEL CLOUD Unlimited Storage
description:
- Backup photos and videos.
- Preview photos and videos on cloud without downloading to your device (supported formats only).
- Organise your files in folders.
- Download multiple files/folders as (.zip) via the app or from your account on https://pixelcloud.app/my-cloud.

Required Subscriptions:
Unlimited Storage - Monthly €6.99
Unlimited Storage - Annual €69.99

Delete your account:
- Go to https://pixelcloud.app/my-account/ or from the app click on Account button.
- Login using your email and password.
- Navigate to Delete Account.
- Confirm your password.

Privacy & Terms of Use :
https://pixelcloud.app/terms-of-use/
